newsitem.title: USA: Culligan buys U.K. water engineering firm.
newsitem.headline: Culligan buys U.K. water engineering firm.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc said Wednesday it acquired Dewplan Ltd, a water engineering and contracting company in a deal worth about $8 million.
Culligan said Dewplan is one of the largest design contractors for industrial water treatment systems in the United Kingdom, posting annual sales of $21 million.

Separately, Culligan said its operation in the Caribbean modified its contract with the government of the island of St. Maarten to increase revenues by $4 million through 2001. The pact, now worth $24 million, calls for Culligan-Enerserve to desalinate 2.6 million gallons of water each day for local residents.
Culligan makes and distributes water treatment products.
Its shares were trading down 3/8 Wednesday at 37-1/4.
